visual_form.composition_law: One unworked emblem or seed before differentiation.
visual_form.spatial_logic: A single suit-bearing form appears alone with generous open ground and no competing system.
visual_form.figure_ground: The seed is unmistakable but not yet built into a world.

visual_form.composition_law: Irreducible duality held in tension or balance.
visual_form.spatial_logic: Two poles mirror, oppose, or choose across one active interval, gate, or hinge.
visual_form.figure_ground: The relation between two forms remains visibly charged.

visual_form.composition_law: Three forces join into the first workable structure.
visual_form.spatial_logic: A triangular or three-part relation visibly produces a new stable possibility without yet enclosing it.
visual_form.rhythm: Two gather; the third completes first form.
visual_form.figure_ground: The emergent structure is clearer than any isolated emblem.

visual_form.spatial_logic: Corners, walls, posts, or balanced quadrants form a frame capable of holding and protecting the suit.

visual_form.composition_law: Established order breaks under an irreducible trial.
visual_form.spatial_logic: A prior frame is contested, scattered, cracked, emptied, or forced to spend itself under pressure.
visual_form.figure_ground: The break/gap/strain becomes the focal figure.

visual_form.composition_law: Reciprocity restores flow at a higher level.
visual_form.spatial_logic: Two fields exchange through a circulating, bridging, or balanced relation that visibly resolves earlier strain.
visual_form.figure_ground: The channel of exchange is central.

visual_form.composition_law: One chooser faces a branching crossroads.
visual_form.spatial_logic: Several paths/options fan from a single held figure or center; one direction must eventually be chosen.
visual_form.figure_ground: The fork and solitary chooser dominate.

visual_form.composition_law: Disciplined repetition becomes mastery or excess.
visual_form.spatial_logic: Repeated suit-actions move in one organized direction; the same pattern can read as skill or as swarming beyond control.

visual_form.composition_law: Near-complete abundance gathers around an inward center.
visual_form.spatial_logic: Many suit-forms accumulate into a mature field while one figure/void holds the last interval before completion.
visual_form.figure_ground: The near-complete whole and its remaining interval read together.

visual_form.composition_law: Completion overflows through a threshold into the next cycle.
visual_form.spatial_logic: The suit reaches saturation and visibly crosses, hands over, spills, or seeds beyond the frame that contained it.
visual_form.figure_ground: The outgoing boundary/threshold carries the transition.

visual_form.composition_law: A novice studies the emblem rather than commanding it.
visual_form.spatial_logic: One youthful/new figure and one suit-token share a simple instructional field with ample room still unexplored.
visual_form.figure_ground: The learner remains smaller than the tradition/world being entered.

visual_form.composition_law: The suit is carried decisively into motion.
visual_form.spatial_logic: A strong outward vector takes emblem, body, or deed from the center into the world/road.
visual_form.figure_ground: Motion and consequence are both visible.

visual_form.composition_law: The suit's wisdom is internalized into still sight.
visual_form.spatial_logic: A seated/still center gathers the suit's symbols inward, often around face, hands, book, reflection, or inner light.
visual_form.rhythm: Receptive recurrence around a quiet center.
visual_form.density: Rich near the center, sparse outward.
visual_form.figure_ground: Stillness organizes the field more than action does.

visual_form.composition_law: Embodied mastery becomes the standard around which others orient.
visual_form.spatial_logic: A commanding exemplar occupies or defines the axis of the full field; subordinate forms visibly take measure from that center.
visual_form.figure_ground: Figure and surrounding order read as one mastered system.
